steps.title: Buy a maple shortbow and some …
steps.text: Buy a maple shortbow and some arrows in Varrock. You could use knives instead but the shorter range makes it more difficult

steps.title: Get your noted super restores out …
steps.text: Get your noted super restores out of your bag if you don't have them

steps.title: Bag anything that isn't needed for …
steps.text: Bag anything that isn't needed for the fight. — The crystal bow will need to be reverted into a seed

steps.title: wear a fire staff. — You …
steps.text: wear a fire staff. — You could go for a water staff, but it doesn't really matter since it won't save an inventory slot

steps.title: Start out by making a Guthix …
steps.text: Start out by making a Guthix rest with the herbs you left planted from farming. If you forgot to do this, then you could farm them now, or just use a karambwan/pineapple pizza

steps.text: Get a candle from Catherby

steps.text: Buy a lockpick from Burthope

steps.text: Thieve Dorgesh Kaan rich chests until you get 9 uncut diamonds and a sapphire

steps.title: Make 9 phoenix necklaces
steps.text: Make 9 phoenix necklaces

steps.text: Make an amulet of magic

steps.text: Get your Mage Arena cape out of your house

steps.title: equip it
steps.text: equip it

steps.title: If you have a stored mystic …
steps.text: If you have a stored mystic robes set in your house, get those or buy a full set at the Wizards' Guild. — You could optionally go buy rune gloves for a slight upgrade

steps.title: Buy 700 blood, death, and water …
steps.text: Buy 700 blood, death, and water runes. This is more than you should need, but it is best to be safe

steps.title: Clear out your rune pouch of …
steps.text: Clear out your rune pouch of other runes and put the deaths, bloods, and waters in it for space. If you have a lot of law runes, you can put most of them in your bag

steps.title: Collect 10 cave nightshade. You will …
steps.text: Collect 10 cave nightshade. You will need to reobtain the skavid map. — Practice eating a few nightshade to get used to it. Eating a nightshade is a right click option with a text box! — The extra nightshade is there in case you mess up and need 1 more.

steps.title: Drop the candle
steps.text: Drop the candle

steps.title: Ring of dueling to the Emir's …
steps.text: Ring of dueling to the Emir's Arena, go south into the desert all the way to the ancients pyramid. You can take the boat to Tempoross to get there faster

steps.title: Change to the ancient spellbook
steps.text: Change to the ancient spellbook

steps.title: You could buy an ancient staff …
steps.text: You could buy an ancient staff from Elbis to replace your fire staff. Keep in mind though that the ancient staff can only be obtained once this way and you should be manual casting in the fight anyway to control which spell you use.

steps.title: Ring of dueling to Clan Wars …
steps.text: Ring of dueling to Clan Wars and restore your stats, head to Edgeville

steps.title: Unnote 3 super restores and bag …
steps.text: Unnote 3 super restores and bag any extra noted restores you have. — You will need to drop something on the ground, return for it after you bag them

steps.title: Minigame teleport to the Fishing Trawler, …
steps.text: Minigame teleport to the Fishing Trawler, Take the charter ship to Port Tyras
